verdict.rationale: The pack documents a strong local-first privacy posture: anonymous use, no telemetry, items not stored on third-party servers, and storage in the user's own cloud. None of it explicitly addresses AI model training, either as a policy commitment or as a user control. Under the partial-credit boundary, these adjacent privacy properties cannot stand in for an AI-training protection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
